what_to_do.en: Tap the sentence with a describing word.

stages.choice_rule: Write four full grammatical sentences. Exactly one is the stem plus one size, color, look, feel, or how-word from the wordlist or allowed_extra_words. The other three only add too, also, again, a time word, a number word, another person, another noun, or a determiner swap. Never copy the stem. One right answer.

choices: The big dog ran.
The dog ran too.
The dog ran also.
The dog ran again.
The bird sat too.
The bird sat also.
The red bird sat.
The bird sat again.
The pig ate too.
The pink pig ate.
The pig ate also.
The pig ate again.

gold_items.stem: The kitten sat on the bed.
choices: The kitten sat on the bed too.
The kitten sat on one bed.
The kitten sat on the bed again.
The fluffy kitten sat on the bed.
<NAME> ate the soup too.
<NAME> ate the hot soup.
<NAME> ate the soup again.
<NAME> and mom ate the soup.

gold_items.stem: The kids play in the yard.
choices: The kids play in the sunny yard.
The kids play in the yard today.
The kids play in one yard.
The kids and mom play in the yard.
The boy ran to school yesterday.
The boy ran to school today.
The boy ran slowly to school.
The boy and sister ran to school.

gold_items.stem: The rain fell on the roof.
choices: The rain fell on the roof yesterday.
The rain and hail fell on the roof.
The rain fell on that roof.
The heavy rain fell on the roof.

roots: The correct choice is the stem with one describing word added. Never reuse the stem as a choice.
Tier 1 wrong choices add only too, also, or again.
Tier 2 wrong choices add a time word, a number word, or another person.
Tier 3 wrong choices look like extra facts: yesterday, today, another noun, or a determiner swap.
Every choice must be a grammatical kid sentence. Do not use broken grammar as a trick.
Put only one describing word in the right choice. Never write two right answers.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of three to five words. The right choice adds a clear size or color word. Wrong choices only add too, also, or again.
tier_rules.2: Stems of five to seven words. The right choice adds a look or feel word. Wrong choices add today, again, one, too, or another person.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss extra facts. The right choice adds a how-word or a two-syllable look word. Wrong choices add yesterday, today, another noun, or a determiner swap.

size_or_color.en: Add a size or color word to tell more about it.
size_or_color.ko: 크기나 색깔을 나타내는 말을 더해 더 자세히 알려 주세요.

look_or_feel.en: Add a word that tells how it looks or feels.
look_or_feel.ko: 어떻게 보이거나 느껴지는지 알려 주는 말을 더하세요.

how_word.en: Add a word that tells how it happens.
how_word.ko: 어떻게 일어나는지 알려 주는 말을 더하세요.
